description: This file provides utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing them in a custom LinkedList structure. It includes a main splitting function and helper methods for validating tokens and adding them to the list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens based on spaces and stores valid tokens in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is non-empty.
